cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, a kind doctor and nurse, and the puppy Max. Body parts shown on a child pointing at them; illness and accidents stay gentle and end well.

words.en: Lily points to the parts of her body.
words.sz: Lily 指出她身体的各个部分。
words.scene: Lily doing a star jump, arms and legs out.
more: Tom draws a big body and a small head.
Tom 画一个大身体和一个小小的头。
Running is good exercise for your whole body.
跑步对你的整个身体都是很好的锻炼。

words.en: Lily puts her hands on her head.
words.scene: Lily standing in her bedroom laughing, both hands on the top of her head, Tom clapping beside the bed, pyjamas and messy morning hair.
more: Grandpa puts his glasses on his head.
爷爷把眼镜推到头上。
Dad wears a hat on his head in the sun.
太阳下爸爸头上戴着帽子。

words.en: Lily washes her face in the morning.
words.scene: Lily at the bathroom sink splashing water on her face with both hands, eyes shut, a small towel in Mum's hand beside her.
more: Tom's face is red after his run.
Tom 跑完步脸红红的。
Mum dries Tom's face with a towel.
妈妈用毛巾给 Tom 擦干脸。

words.en: Lily has long brown hair.
words.sz: Lily 有一头棕色的长发。
words.scene: Lily sitting on a low stool while Mum combs her long brown hair with a pink comb, Tom holding a hair band and laughing.
more: Mum cuts Grandma's hair in the garden.
妈妈在花园里给奶奶剪头发。
Tom's hair is wet after his bath.
Tom 洗完澡头发湿了。

words.en: Tom gets soap in his eye.
words.sz: Tom 的眼睛里进了肥皂。
words.scene: Tom in the bathroom holding one hand over one eye, his other eye wide open, looking surprised but not crying, Mum beside him with a warm towel.
more: Lily has big brown eyes.
Lily 有一双棕色的大眼睛。
Close your eyes, Tom. One, two, three!
Tom，闭上眼睛。一、二、三！

words.en: Tom's ear hurts, so we see the doctor.
words.sz: Tom 的耳朵疼，所以我们去看医生。
words.scene: Tom sitting on a chair in the sitting room, head tilted, pointing at one ear with one finger, Mum kneeling beside him with a calm smile, Max at her feet.
more: Lily has small ears and long hair.
Lily 有小耳朵和长头发。
Max moves his ears when he hears a sound.
Max 听到声音会动耳朵。

words.en: Tom has a cold, so his nose is red.
words.sz: Tom 感冒了，所以他的鼻子红红的。
words.scene: Tom on the sofa holding a paper tissue to his nose, a warm drink on the table beside him, Mum pulling a blanket over his knees.
more: Lily has a small nose.
Lily 有一个小鼻子。
Max puts his cold nose on Tom's hand.
Max 把他凉凉的鼻子贴在 Tom 的手上。

words.en: Tom has a bad tooth.
words.scene: Tom in the bathroom opening his mouth wide and grinning, pointing with one finger at one tooth with a small dark spot, Mum beside him with the toothbrush.
more: Tom brushes his teeth twice a day.
Tom 一天刷两次牙。
A tooth falls out and Tom shows Mum.
掉了一颗牙，Tom 拿给妈妈看。

words.en: Mum ties a scarf round Tom's neck.
words.sz: 妈妈给 Tom 的脖子围上围巾。
words.scene: Tom in the snow with a thick red scarf around his neck, pointing at the scarf with one mitten, Mum tying the knot, snowflakes falling.
more: Lily turns her neck to look at the bird.
Lily 转过头去看那只鸟。
Dad has a pain in his neck today.
爸爸今天脖子疼。

words.en: Show me your arm, Tom!
words.scene: Tom in the kitchen holding one arm straight out, Mum holding it gently and looking at a small plaster on it, Lily watching with a smile.
more: Lily rides her bike with both arms out.
Lily 两只胳膊伸开骑自行车。
Dad carries the shopping bag in his left arm.
爸爸左胳膊挎着购物袋。

words.en: Lily washes her hands with soap.
words.scene: Lily at the sink holding up both hands covered in white foam, water running from the tap, a green towel on the rail beside her.
more: Tom hurts his hand, but it is fine.
Tom 的手受伤了，不过没事。
Lily holds up one clean hand.
Lily 举起一只干净的手。

words.en: Tom has a small cut on his finger.
words.sz: Tom 的手指上有一个小口子。
words.scene: Tom in the sitting room holding up one finger with a small plaster on it, Mum kneeling in front of him smiling, Max sniffing at his shoe.
more: Lily has ten strong fingers.
Lily 有十根结实的手指。
Tom points at the moon with one finger.
Tom 用一根手指指着月亮。

words.en: Lily lies on her back on the grass.
words.scene: Lily lying on her back on the green grass in the park, her arms by her sides, a red kite in the sky above her, Max asleep beside her shoes.
more: Tom puts his bag on his back and walks out.
Tom 把包背在背上就出门了。
Dad carries little Tom on his back.
爸爸把小 Tom 背在背上。

words.en: Dad comes back at six.
words.scene: Dad coming back in through the open front door in the evening, his coat on and his bag in his hand, Tom running to hug his legs, the hall light warm.
more: Mum goes back inside for the keys.
妈妈回屋里去拿钥匙。
Lily puts her toys back in the box.
Lily 把玩具放回盒子里。

words.en: Lily runs fast on her long legs.
words.sz: Lily 用她的长腿跑得很快。
words.scene: Tom sitting on the grass with both legs straight out in front of him and pointing at them, Max lying down beside his feet, one ear up.
more: Dad dries Max's legs after his bath.
爸爸给 Max 擦干腿。
Tom hurts his leg, but he can still walk.
Tom 的腿受伤了，但他还能走。

words.en: Lily stands on one foot.
words.scene: Lily balancing on one bare foot on the garden path, arms out, her other foot tucked up, Tom counting on his fingers beside her.
more: Tom puts his feet in the cold water.
Tom 把脚放进冷水里。
Mum washes Tom's feet after the beach.
去完海滩妈妈给 Tom 洗脚。

words.en: Tom's stomach is full after dinner.
words.sz: 晚饭后 Tom 的肚子饱了。
words.scene: Tom leaning back on the kitchen chair with both hands on his round stomach, his plate empty in front of him, Mum smiling down at him.
more: Tom lies down and holds his stomach.
Tom 躺下，抱着肚子。
Is your stomach better now, Tom?
Tom，你的肚子好些了吗？

words.en: Lily listens to Dad's heart.
words.scene: Lily listening to Dad's heart with a toy stethoscope, Dad sitting on the sofa with his shirt open a little over his chest, both of them smiling.
more: My heart goes very fast after a run.
跑完步我的心跳得很快。
Tom draws a big red heart for Mum.
Tom 给妈妈画一颗红色的大心。

words.en: Your brain helps you learn new words.
words.sz: 你的大脑帮你学新单词。
words.scene: Lily thinking hard at her desk with an open book, smiling, a cute cartoon pink brain in a thought bubble above her head.
more: Lily's brain is busy at school.
Lily 在学校时大脑一直在动。
Sleep is good for Tom's brain.
睡觉对 Tom 的大脑有好处。

words.en: The nurse takes a little blood from Dad.
words.sz: 护士取了一点爸爸的血去化验。
words.scene: Tom sitting on a garden step holding up one finger with a tiny drop of red blood on his finger, Mum kneeling and gently putting a plaster on it, Tom smiling bravely.
more: Dad is not afraid of the blood test.
爸爸不怕这个血化验。
There is a little blood on Tom's finger, but he is fine.
Tom 的手指上有一点血，不过他没事。

words.en: Fruit is good for your health.
words.scene: Lily standing tall and smiling in a sunny garden after riding her bike, her helmet in one hand, a bowl of fruit and a glass of water on the table beside her, Max running happily around her legs.
more: Running and walking keep us healthy.
跑步和走路让我们保持健康。
Mum looks after our health every day.
妈妈每天照顾我们的健康。

words.en: Lily is ill today.
words.scene: Lily lying on the sofa under a blanket with a pale tired face, half-closed eyes, a thermometer in her mouth, not smiling, Mum sitting beside her with a worried face.
more: Tom was ill last week.
Tom 上星期生病了。
Grandma is ill, so we visit her.
奶奶生病了，所以我们去看她。

words.en: Tom feels sick.
words.scene: Tom sitting on the bathroom floor beside the sink, holding his stomach with both hands and looking sick and unhappy, Mum kneeling beside him with a soft cloth, Lily holding his hair back.
more: Mum feels sick in the car.
妈妈坐车会想吐。
When Tom is sick, Mum brings him soup.
Tom 生病时，妈妈给他端汤。

words.en: Grandpa has a pain in his back.
words.scene: Grandpa sitting in an armchair and leaning forward, holding his lower back with both hands and frowning, Mum standing behind him with a worried face, a warm blanket on the chair.
more: The pain is bad at night.
晚上疼得厉害。
The pain goes away quickly.
疼痛很快就消了。

words.en: My leg hurts.
words.scene: Lily sitting on the path beside her fallen bike, holding her scraped knee with both hands, her face in pain, eyes squeezed, not smiling, Sam kneeling beside her.
more: Lily fell off her bike and hurt her leg.
Lily 从自行车上摔下来，伤了腿。
Did you hurt your arm, Tom?
Tom，你的胳膊受伤了吗？

words.en: Tom has a stomach ache.
words.scene: Tom sitting on a kitchen chair holding his stomach with both hands and making a sad face, Mum rubbing his back, a bowl of warm soup on the table in front of him.
more: Lily has a bad stomach ache.
Lily 肚子疼得厉害。
I have a stomach ache after too many sweets.
吃太多糖以后我肚子疼。

words.en: Tom has a bad toothache.
words.scene: Tom on a chair holding one swollen cheek with his hand, his face in pain, eyebrows up, eyes watery, not smiling.
more: Lily goes to the dentist because of a toothache.
Lily 因为牙疼去看牙医。
Too much sugar gives Lily a toothache.
太多糖让 Lily 牙疼。

words.en: Tom has a high temperature.
words.scene: Mum sitting on the bed beside Tom, holding a small thermometer to check his temperature, Tom with a warm red face and sleepy eyes under a light blanket, a cup of water on the table.
more: Mum takes Tom's temperature twice a day.
妈妈一天给 Tom 量两次体温。
The temperature outside is low today.
今天外面的温度很低。
senses: The temperature outside is low today.

words.en: Wear warm clothes. It's cold outside.
words.sz: 穿暖和的衣服，外面很冷。
more: It's cold in the morning.
早上很冷。
Tom's hands are cold.
Tom 的手很冷。

words.en: Tom has a cold.
words.scene: Tom sitting up in bed with a red nose, holding a paper tissue to his face as he sneezes, a cup of warm drink on the table beside him, Mum pulling the blanket up over his knees.
more: Lily has a cold, so she stays at home.
Lily 感冒了，所以她待在家里。
Tom's cold goes away in two days.
Tom 的感冒两天就好了。

words.en: Tom takes his medicine with water.
words.scene: Mum standing at the kitchen table with a small cup of brown medicine and a spoon, Tom sitting on his chair opening his mouth, Lily laughing beside him.
more: Mum gives Tom some medicine.
妈妈给 Tom 吃些药。
The medicine is sweet.
这药是甜的。

words.en: Mum takes Tom to the doctor.
words.sz: 妈妈带 Tom 去看医生。
words.scene: A kind grown-up man doctor in a white coat sitting at his desk, listening to Tom's chest with a stethoscope, Tom sitting on a high chair with his eyes wide, Mum beside him.
more: The doctor helps you get better.
医生帮你好起来。
Lily wants to be a doctor.
Lily 想当医生。

words.en: Dr Brown is very kind.
words.scene: A friendly grown-up woman doctor in a white coat standing at her door and waving, Lily and Mum walking in with big smiles, a bright waiting room behind the doctor.
more: We see Dr Brown at eight.
我们八点去看 Brown 医生。
Dr Brown helps Grandma.
Brown 医生帮助奶奶。

words.en: The nurse takes Tom's temperature.
words.sz: 护士给 Tom 量体温。
words.scene: A smiling grown-up nurse in a blue uniform and white cap holding Tom's hand while he sits on a hospital bed, Lily standing on a chair beside her and waving, a small lamp on the wall.
more: A nurse works in the hospital.
护士在医院里工作。
The nurse helps you get well.
护士帮你好起来。

words.en: We see the dentist twice a year.
words.scene: Lily sitting in a big green dentist's chair with her mouth open, a smiling grown-up dentist in a white coat leaning over her with a small mirror, Mum standing behind the chair.
more: Tom is not afraid of the dentist.
Tom 不怕牙医。
The dentist looks at Lily's teeth.
牙医看看 Lily 的牙齿。

words.en: Mum buys medicine at the chemist's.
words.scene: Mum at the counter of a small shop, the chemist in a white coat handing her a small brown box, tall shelves of bottles and cream jars behind the counter, nothing written anywhere.
more: The chemist is near our house.
药店在我们家附近。
The chemist helps Mum.
药剂师帮了妈妈的忙。

words.en: Grandma is in hospital.
words.scene: A big white hospital building with an ambulance parked at the door, Lily and Tom walking up the steps with Mum, Tom holding a big bunch of flowers, the sun coming out.
more: Mum works in a hospital.
妈妈在医院工作。
Lily and Tom visit Grandma in hospital.
Lily 和 Tom 去医院看奶奶。

words.en: The ambulance is white and yellow.
words.sz: 救护车是白色和黄色的。
words.scene: A white ambulance with its lights on driving along a road, no writing anywhere on it, Dad waving it in from the side, Lily and Tom standing with Mum on the pavement behind a low fence.
more: Listen! An ambulance is coming.
听！救护车来了。
An ambulance can go very fast.
救护车可以开得很快。

words.en: Tom has an appointment with the dentist.
words.scene: Mum and Tom sitting on chairs in a bright doctor's waiting room, a tall round clock on the wall with its hands at two, Lily holding up a book with only pictures in it, a big plant in the corner.
more: Mum calls to make an appointment.
妈妈打电话预约。
Tom's appointment is at two o'clock.
Tom 的预约在两点钟。

words.en: Tom drops a glass of milk by accident.
words.sz: Tom 不小心打翻了一杯牛奶。
words.scene: Tom standing by the kitchen table looking down at a glass and a big white splash of milk on the floor, Mum kneeling and smiling as she wipes it up with a cloth, Lily putting her hand over her mouth.
more: Lily has an accident on her bike.
Lily 骑自行车时出了意外。
It was a small accident, and nobody was hurt.
那是个小意外，没有人受伤。

words.en: Lily's toothbrush is blue and green.
words.sz: Lily 的牙刷是蓝绿相间的。
words.scene: One big blue and green toothbrush standing in a cup on a bathroom shelf, with a small tube beside it and a clean sink in front, nothing written on the tube.
more: Tom puts his toothbrush in the cup.
Tom 把牙刷放在杯子里。
Brush your teeth with your toothbrush, Tom!
Tom，用你的牙刷刷牙！

words.en: Wash your hands with soap, Tom!
words.scene: Tom at the sink washing his hands with a big pink bar of soap, white foam on his hands, Mum standing beside him and smiling.
more: Mum buys soap at the shop.
妈妈在商店买肥皂。
The soap is next to the sink.
肥皂在水池旁边。

words.en: Where is my comb, Mum?
words.scene: One big purple comb lying on its own on a clean white shelf in the bathroom.
more: Lily has a new pink comb.
Lily 有一把新的粉色梳子。
Use a clean comb, Tom.
Tom，用一把干净的梳子。

words.en: Tom's hands are clean.
words.scene: Tom holding up his clean hands and smiling at the sink, a bar of soap and a towel beside the tap, water running.
more: Lily helps Mum clean the kitchen.
Lily 帮妈妈打扫厨房。
Mum cleans the table after dinner.
妈妈晚饭后擦桌子。
senses: Lily helps Mum clean the kitchen.

words.en: Exercise is good for children.
words.scene: Lily doing exercises on a blue mat in the garden, bending down and touching her toes, Dad stretching beside her, Max watching.
more: Lily exercises every morning with Dad.
Lily 每天早上和爸爸一起锻炼。
Grandpa does his exercises in the garden.
爷爷在花园里做他的练习。
senses: Lily exercises every morning with Dad.

words.en: Grandpa runs every day, so he is very fit.
words.sz: 爷爷每天跑步，所以他很健康。
words.scene: Grandpa in his sports clothes in the garden, smiling and bending his arm to show his strong muscles, Lily laughing beside him.
more: Swimming keeps Lily fit.
游泳让 Lily 保持健康。
Mum is fit and strong.
妈妈身体健康，很强壮。

words.en: I don't feel well.
words.scene: Lily feeling well and happy, carrying a small shopping bag up the garden steps with a big smile, Max running around her legs, bright sunshine.
more: Lily sings very well.
Lily 唱歌唱得很好。
Are you well today, Grandma?
Grandma，你今天身体好吗？

words.en: How do you feel today, Tom?
words.scene: Tom sitting on the sofa with his hand on his head, Mum kneeling in front of him and asking how he feels, a warm blanket over his knees.
more: I feel ill today.
我今天觉得不舒服。
Mum feels better now.
妈妈现在感觉好多了。

words.en: I can hear a bird.
words.scene: Lily holding her hand behind her ear, listening to a small bird singing on a tree branch in the garden.
more: Can you hear the music, Tom?
Tom，你能听见音乐吗？
We can hear Max at the door.
我们能听见 Max 在门口。

words.en: The doctor checks my ears.
words.scene: The doctor in a white coat looking into Lily's ear with a small light while she sits on a chair, Mum standing behind her.
more: Let's check the bike before we go.
我们出门前先检查一下自行车。
Mum checks Tom's temperature twice a day.
妈妈一天给 Tom 量两次体温。

words.en: Tom falls off his bike.
words.sz: Tom 从自行车上摔下来。
words.scene: Tom in the middle of falling off his bike in the park, the bike tipping over and Tom flying sideways towards the grass, his helmet on, his mouth open in surprise.
more: Leaves fall in autumn.
树叶在秋天落下。
Lily had a small fall, but she is fine.
Lily 摔了一小跤，但她没事。
senses: Lily had a small fall, but she is fine.

words.en: Lie down and rest, Tom.
words.scene: Tom lying down on the sofa under a soft blanket with his eyes closed, his shoes on the floor beside the sofa, Max asleep at his feet.
more: Tom lies down on the sofa.
Tom 躺在沙发上。
Mum lies down for an hour.
妈妈躺一个小时。

words.en: You are tired. Have a rest.
more: Lily rests on the sofa for an hour.
Lily 在沙发上休息一个小时。
Rest helps your body get better.
休息帮助你的身体好起来。

words.en: Grandpa runs every morning to stay fit.
words.sz: 爷爷每天早上跑步来保持健康。
more: I run with Sam twice a week.
我一周和 Sam 跑两次步。
Running is good for your heart.
跑步对你的心脏有好处。

words.en: Lily swims twice a week.
more: We swim in the pool with Dad.
我们和爸爸在泳池里游泳。
Swimming is good exercise.
游泳是很好的锻炼。

words.en: Lily walks to school every morning.
words.sz: Lily 每天早上走路上学。
more: Grandpa and Dad walk in the park.
爷爷和爸爸在公园里散步。
A short walk every day is good for you.
每天走一小段路对你有好处。

words.en: Tom is tired after his swim.
more: I feel tired and I need a rest.
我觉得累，需要休息。
Mum is tired in the evening, but happy.
妈妈晚上很累，但很开心。

words.en: Take a break if you feel tired.
words.sz: 如果觉得累，就休息一下。
more: We have a break after twenty minutes.
二十分钟后我们休息一下。
A short break helps Lily learn better.
短暂的休息让 Lily 学得更认真。

words.en: I have a small cut on my finger.
words.sz: 我手指上有一个小口子。
more: Tom cuts his finger with a knife.
Tom 用刀割破了手指。
The cut is small, and it is better now.
口子很小，现在已经好多了。

words.en: Max runs to Lily when he sees danger.
words.sz: Max 一看到危险就跑到 Lily 身边。
words.scene: Max the puppy barking with his fur up, standing in front of Lily on a forest path, a big snake on the path ahead of them; Lily stepping back.
more: Lily learns about danger at school.
Lily 在学校学习怎样面对危险。
Grandpa tells us about the danger of fire.
爷爷给我们讲火的危险。

words.en: Fire is dangerous, so we stay away.
words.sz: 火是危险的，所以我们离远一点。
words.scene: The edge of a high cliff by the sea with a wooden fence and a red triangle warning sign with a picture of a falling rock, Dad holding Tom's hand and pulling him back from the fence.
more: That knife is dangerous, Tom.
Tom，那把刀很危险。
It is dangerous to run across the road.
跑着过马路很危险。

words.en: The flower is dead.
words.scene: One dry brown dead flower in a flowerpot on a garden table, next to a pot with a bright healthy flower in it.
more: These leaves are brown and dead.
这些叶子是棕色的，已经枯死了。
Grandma cuts away the dead flowers.
奶奶把枯死的花剪掉。

words.en: Plants die without water.
words.scene: Lily watering a drooping green plant in a pot with a small watering can, water running into the soil, sunshine on the kitchen window behind her.
more: The plant died because we forgot the water.
这株植物枯死了，因为我们忘了浇水。
Flowers die quickly in hot weather.
天气热的时候花很快就会枯死。

words.en: The baby is healthy and strong.
words.scene: A happy baby sitting on the doctor's table and laughing, the nurse kneeling beside her and holding up a small soft toy, a bright room with balls and bricks on a shelf.
more: The nurse checks the baby every week.
护士每周给这个婴儿做检查。
Mia has a new baby sister.
Mia 有了一个新的小妹妹。

words.en: What's the problem, Tom?
words.scene: Tom pointing at his arm and frowning, Mum kneeling in front of him and looking at his arm with a kind face, Max sitting beside them in the sitting room.
more: There is no problem. You are fine.
没有问题，你没事。
Tom has a problem with his maths homework.
Tom 的数学作业遇到了问题。
